name: Paperclip
instruction: Compare a standard paperclip to one with a triangular shape. Create a 3D model of each.

Shape accuracy: The standard paperclip has a rounded, elongated shape.
The triangular paperclip has three distinct edges forming a triangle.
Both paperclips maintain a consistent thickness throughout.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The standard paperclip is typically around 5 cm in length.
The triangular paperclip's dimensions should be proportionate to its shape.
Proportion: The width of the standard paperclip is proportionate to its length.
The triangular paperclip maintains equal lengths for all three sides.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: Both paperclips are modeled to be free-standing.
The standard paperclip should be able to rest flat on a surface.
The triangular paperclip should also rest flat, with all three points touching the surface.
Object distance and contact: There should be no overlapping between the two models.
The distance between the two paperclips should be sufficient to distinguish their shapes.

Instruction execution accuracy: Both paperclips are accurately represented as per the instruction.
The comparison between the two shapes is clear and distinct.
